interaction: Read the CV as a code editor: open files from the explorer (a dropdown on phones) into closable tabs with hand-built syntax highlighting, a Markdown preview, an outline and a draggable minimap; ⌘K / Ctrl+K opens a fuzzy command palette; Run ▶ types out contact.sh in the terminal, where you can copy the email or answer a prompt-style message form that ends in a demo-only notice; light/dark theme toggle.
notes: Files are read-only (no text editing); the terminal only 'runs' contact.sh and its message prompt; the person, employers and contact details are fictional.
